tasks.short: Design plans for a new transportation system

steps.what: Read the corridor record and design standards
Enter speed, lanes and design vehicle
Choose the layout in the design meeting
Draft plan notes from the criteria fields

loop.input: criteria fields and the plan-note template
loop.output: notes where each number cites a field
loop.check: Every speed, lane count and clause id equals a field on the criteria sheet
loop.stop: One pass, then leave the section blank if a cited field is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: The reason for a layout differs by corridor and a fixed line cannot write it

steps.what: Draw the plan sheets for the new system
Mark omissions against the standards list
Sign the new-system plan version
File the signed plan set

tasks.design: Corridor id, design speed, lane count, design vehicle and standard clause ids sit on a {SPREADSHEET}. A bounded note in {DOCS} drafts the plan text from those fields only. The transportation engineer draws the sheets and signs one version. A machine does not stamp the drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Criteria lived in old plan sets and mail, so a draft would have copied a stale speed or lane count.
tasks.enabler_now: The corridor record can hold the same ids the plan note must cite, so a blank field can stop a section.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the layout for a highway, street or bridge is still a design judgement, and the drawing is still made by hand.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses the layout and signs the plan. A generated sketch is not the signed sheet.

ambition.what: Sign a plan version at each design gate, not only when the package is finished

tasks.altitude: Less time retyping notes, the same duty to draw and to refuse a plan whose criteria do not match the record.

reach.task: Mark omissions on a new transportation plan
reach.learn: Which plan version is signed and which clause ids are still blank

evidence.claim: In a mid-size firm a new transport plan is a criteria sheet plus drawings. The layout is the engineer's choice, not a text draft.
Digest [S4] says a civil-site design product announced generative layout help. That help is design drafting only, and a person still signs. It does not check calculations.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a model-written number is not filed unless it traces to a field.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in road traffic can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. This design does not let a model decide a safety function. The transportation engineer still signs.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when a signed plan version is filed. Site inspection and construction supervision are later tasks.

Input contract: corridor id, design speed, lane count, design vehicle, standard clause ids, outfall id. Producer is the project controller on the corridor record. If a field is empty the engineer types it and marks the row manual.
Use the document store's own templates before custom code. Drawing and the layout choice stay manual, so their time is not treated as saved.
The hours prior loads meetings heavily. A design meeting remains, because the layout is agreed there. The sheets themselves are drawn on a system screen.
unknowns: Which standard clause list is in force for this road authority.
Who may sign a plan when the engineer is absent.
Whether bridges in this firm are drawn by another discipline.
research_questions: How often does a signed speed differ from the corridor record?
Which plan sets are filed with a blank clause id?

already_counted.description: Engineer edits plan notes whose wording is weak
Drawing time on the plan sheets stays with the engineer
Signature time on the plan version stays in the review

incremental.description: Revise the plan-note template when a new facility type is added
Design checker re-marks a sheet after the engineer changes a criterion

approvals.approved_version: new-system plan version signed in this review
the same signed new-system plan version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the corridor record is mostly blank, so the engineer retypes criteria and still draws every sheet. The high case assumes the fields are present, while the design meeting, the drawing and the signature stay. Construction is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check plans, calculations and cost estimations

steps.what: Submit the plan package for checking
Open sheets against the standards list
Apply coded rules for missing sheets and units
Recheck the design calculations on the sheet
Test estimate lines as quantity times price
Write exceptions that cite a sheet or a row

loop.input: rule hits and calculation sample rows
loop.output: exception note that cites sheet or row ids
loop.check: Every exception cites a sheet id or an estimate row id that was opened
loop.stop: One pass, then drop any sentence with no id
loop.why_not_simpler: The words for why a calculation fails practice are not a fixed lookup

steps.what: Sign the plan-check result

tasks.design: A checklist in {DOCS} runs coded rules for missing sheets, units and title data. The transportation engineer rechecks the design calculations on the {SPREADSHEET} and samples cost lines as quantity times price. The exception note cites a sheet or a row, and the engineer signs the result.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review comments sat in mail and on paper mark-ups, so a later check could not tell which sheet a comment referred to.
tasks.enabler_now: Sheet ids, units and estimate rows can be tested by coded rules. The arithmetic of a design calculation still cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Conformity of a calculation to engineering practice is a judgement, and a coded rule does not make it.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer redoes the sample calculations and decides whether the package conforms.

ambition.what: Return a signed check in the same week a package arrives, not at the next coordination meeting

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends less time hunting missing sheets and keeps the right to fail a calculation.

reach.task: Resubmit a sheet the check named
reach.learn: Which sheet ids failed a coded rule and which failed a calculation

evidence.claim: Checking a transport package is still a read of drawings, a sample of calculations and a sample of the estimate. Completeness is the part a rule can list.
Digest [S5] says a model-checking product for building models runs coded rules. That fits a plan check for missing sheets and clashes, not a judgement of design calculations.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a figure in the exception note is filed only when it cites a sheet cell.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends at a signed check result. Redrawing the package is the designer's next task, not this one.

Input contract: package id, sheet id, calculation id, quantity, unit, standard clause id. Producer is the design checker with the submitted package. A sheet with no id is listed for a manual look and is not passed by a rule.
Configure the document store's checklist before custom code. Coded rules do not replace the calculation sample.
The hours prior is documents and spreadsheets, not meetings. These steps follow that and do not add a review meeting.
unknowns: Which calculation types must always be sampled by hand.
Whether the estimate uses the same item codes as the price table.
research_questions: What share of check comments are missing sheets rather than wrong calculations?
How often does a sampled line fail quantity times price?

already_counted.description: Calculation sample time stays with the engineer
Signature time on the check stays in the review

incremental.description: Update coded rules when a standard clause id changes
Design checker resubmits sheets the check sent back

approvals.approved_version: plan-check result signed for this package id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes packages arrive as unstructured drawings, so coded rules rarely fire and the engineer still reads every sheet. The high case assumes sheet ids are present, while every calculation sample and the signature stay. The redraw is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write the traffic-operations report from count rows

steps.what: Ask for the traffic report this period
Assemble accident, volume and measure rows
Fill the statistical table from those rows
Draft the report prose with each figure tagged

loop.input: statistical table and the report template
loop.output: commentary where each figure cites a row
loop.check: Every accident count, volume and measure id equals a row in the table
loop.stop: One pass, then delete a sentence whose figure has no row
loop.why_not_simpler: The safety commentary is not a fixed sentence for a given total

steps.what: Review the safety commentary with the controller
Sign the traffic-operations report
File the signed traffic report

tasks.design: Accident counts, pedestrian volumes and measure ids are rows on a {SPREADSHEET}. A template fills the statistical table from those rows, and a bounded draft in {DOCS} writes the commentary with each figure tagged to a row. The transportation engineer signs the report before it is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counts were pasted from old reports, so a figure could not be traced to a site and a period.
tasks.enabler_now: A count row can carry site id, period, accident count, pedestrian volume and measure id, which a table can sum.
tasks.still_hard: What the figures mean for safety practice is still the engineer's commentary, not a total.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what the counts support and signs the report. Untagged figures are dropped.

ambition.what: Issue the traffic report every month from the same count table, not as a one-off rewrite

tasks.altitude: The week loses the retyping of tables. The engineer still judges the safety commentary and signs.

reach.task: Schedule measures named in the signed report
reach.learn: Which measure ids the engineer signed and which count rows were dropped

evidence.claim: A traffic-operations report in a mid-size firm is a table of counts plus a short commentary. The table is the part that can be filled from rows.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a model-written accident or volume figure is not filed without a count row.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed report is filed. Changing a road because of the report is a later task.
Input contract: site id, period, accident count, pedestrian volume, measure id. Producer is the count workbook kept for the project controller. A row with no site id is dropped and listed.
Use the spreadsheet's own table and the document template before custom code. The safety commentary is not a threshold the table can decide.
The hours prior is mostly documents and spreadsheets. A short review with the controller remains. This is not a public hearing.
unknowns: Which count source is the record for accidents.
Whether pedestrian volumes are a sample or a full count.
Who signs when the report goes to an authority.
research_questions: What share of report figures cannot be tied to a site id today?
How often is the commentary changed after the table is filled?

already_counted.description: Engineer edits commentary the table cannot phrase
Safety review time stays with the engineer
Signature time stays on the report review

incremental.description: Add a measure code to the report template when a new practice is tracked
Project controller corrects a count row the table rejected

approvals.approved_version: traffic-operations report signed for this period

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes counts still arrive as free text, so the table is filled by hand and only the template is new. The high case assumes clean rows, while the safety commentary and the signature stay. Measures built later are not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan a safety or function alteration

steps.what: Read condition notes and crash rows
Set the structure limits on the alteration sheet
Choose the alteration in the safety meeting
Draft the alteration note from the chosen option

loop.input: chosen change id and condition rows
loop.output: note that names only that change id
loop.check: The change id in the note equals the chosen alteration, and each crash count cites a row
loop.stop: Stop after one draft if the change id is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Why this option improves function is not a fixed sentence for a defect code

steps.what: Sketch the altered layout on the sheet
Check the sketch against the current layout
Sign the alteration package
File the signed alteration package

tasks.design: Condition notes and crash rows are read on {BI}. The transportation engineer chooses the alteration in a meeting. A {DOCS} note is drafted only for that chosen option, the engineer sketches the layout, and only the signed package is filed. A model does not choose the safety change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Alteration ideas were paragraphs in mail, with no structure id, so a draft could not tell which option had been chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: A condition record can store structure id, defect id and crash count, and the engineer can name one change id before any note is written.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a change improves safety or function is a design judgement. A sketch is not a stamped drawing.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses the alteration and signs it. The note may not invent a second option.

ambition.what: Review an alteration when a new crash cluster is filed, not only in the yearly programme

tasks.altitude: The engineer stops rewriting old alteration notes and keeps the choice of what changes on the structure.

reach.task: Check an alteration sketch against the current layout
reach.learn: Which change id was chosen and which defect ids it claims to address

evidence.claim: Planning a change to an existing road or structure is a meeting plus a sketch. The choice is not a form that can be completed from the defect list alone.
Digest [S4] says a civil-site design product announced generative layout help. That help is drafting only, and a person still signs. It does not choose a safety alteration or check calculations.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in road traffic can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. A model does not decide this safety function. The transportation engineer still signs.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so crash counts in the note must cite a row.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed alteration package is filed. Building the change is later.

Input contract: structure id, defect id, crash count, change id, standard clause id. Producer of the condition rows is the project record. The change id is produced by the engineer in the meeting. No change id means no note is drafted.
Native document templates are tested first. The sketch and the safety choice stay manual.
Meetings are a large share of this task today and remain so. The note is the part that moves.
unknowns: Which crash rows are complete enough to cite.
Whether the structure is owned by another authority.
Who may choose an alteration if the engineer is the designer of the original.
research_questions: How often is an alteration chosen with no defect id?
What share of sketches are redrawn after the checker looks?

already_counted.description: Safety choice time stays in the meeting
Sketch time stays with the engineer
Signature time stays on the package

incremental.description: Keep the alteration template aligned with new structure types
Design checker looks again after a sketch change

approvals.approved_version: alteration choice for this structure id
alteration package signed for this change id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes condition notes are free text, so the engineer still assembles the evidence and still sketches. The high case assumes rows and a change id exist, while the safety meeting, the sketch and the signature stay. Construction of the alteration is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week moves from retyping plans and reports toward criteria, exceptions and safety choices the engineer still signs.
reach: The design checker receives a signed plan set and an omission list instead of an unmarked bundle.
The project controller receives the traffic report with each figure tied to a count row.
skills_to_grow: Write design criteria as fields a plan note can cite.
Separate a coded sheet check from a calculation that is redone by hand.
Keep a safety alteration as a named choice with a source row.
role.ambitious_version: Every live corridor has a signed plan version, a current check result and a traffic report whose figures match the count table.
